title: Power off in 45 minutes
scenario: A caller says your electricity account is overdue and service will be disconnected in 45 minutes. The amount sounds plausible, and they offer to “hold the shutoff” if you pay immediately by card.

answers.A: Ask for the account number and overdue amount, then compare them with your own bill before doing anything.
answers.B: Pay the amount if it matches your normal monthly bill, then dispute it later if necessary.
answers.C: End the call and check your utility account or call the number on a bill or official site.

explanation: Urgency plus a believable amount can create false confidence. Verify the debt independently before paying.
proTip: A familiar bill amount is not proof of a familiar caller.
